# Cooperative Berber Rugs (Rugs Berber)

> Cooperative of rural Amazigh (Berber) women weavers in Taznakht, in the Siroua Mountains of Morocco. Handmade, one-of-a-kind wool Berber rugs sold directly to customers, with worldwide shipping and custom orders.

Each rug is handmade, so every piece is unique and has its own SKU. Prices are listed in USD, EUR and MAD. Orders are placed via WhatsApp or the checkout (bank transfer).

## Collections (rug styles from Taznakht)
- [All collections](https://rugsberber.com/collections)
- [Ouaouzguit](https://rugsberber.com/collections/ouaouzguit)
- [Glaoui](https://rugsberber.com/collections/glaoui)
- [Mouzaïk](https://rugsberber.com/collections/mouzaik)
- [Akhenif](https://rugsberber.com/collections/akhenif)
- [Tapis Tableau](https://rugsberber.com/collections/tableau)
- [Picasso Berber](https://rugsberber.com/collections/picasso)
- [Zanifi](https://rugsberber.com/collections/zanifi)

## Key facts (verify and keep identical to the website text)
- Location: Taznakht, Morocco
- Makers: 13 families (3 in Taznakht, 10 in surrounding villages), since 2003
- Material: sheep's wool from the Siroua Mountains, natural dyes
- Production time: three weeks to four months per rug
- Contact: WhatsApp +212 767 149 114
# Rugs Berber

> Authentic hand-woven Moroccan Berber rugs, made by rural Amazigh women artisans in the Siroua Mountains near Taznakht, Morocco. Natural wool, ancestral symbols, custom orders, worldwide delivery.

## Current offer
- Black Friday sale: 30% off all rugs until November 30, 2026.

## Key pages
- [All rugs](https://rugsberber.com/rugs): full catalogue with sizes and prices
- [Custom order](https://rugsberber.com/custom-order): made-to-measure rugs (size, colors, symbols)

## Facts
- Origin: Taznakht, Siroua Mountains, Morocco
- Material: hand-spun natural wool, hand-woven
- Ordering: via WhatsApp +212 767 149 114
